description: Peloton workout, ride, and music history API. No public spec — reverse-engineered from the members.onepeloton.com Auth0 SPA. Endpoint paths and response shapes can shift unannounced; the auth bearer token is harvested from Auth0 SPA localStorage rather than a documented OAuth flow.

env_var_specs.name: PELOTON_USERNAME
env_var_specs.description: Peloton account email or username consumed by `auth login` to pre-fill the Auth0 sign-in form. Optional — you can sign in by hand inside the spawned Chrome window.

env_var_specs.name: PELOTON_PASSWORD
env_var_specs.description: Peloton account password consumed by `auth login` to pre-fill the Auth0 sign-in form. Optional — you can sign in by hand.

env_var_specs.name: PELOTON_TOKEN
env_var_specs.description: Bearer token populated automatically by `auth login` and read by authenticated commands. Do not set manually — use `auth login` instead. The token is the Auth0 SPA `body.access_token` extracted from the `@@auth0spajs@@::<client_id>::https://api.onepeloton.com/::openid offline_access` localStorage entry; lifetime is ~1 hour Peloton-side.

tools.name: identity_me
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's identity (id, username, profile fields). Used implicitly by every workout query to resolve the user_id. Returns the User.

tools.name: rides_details
tools.description: Get a ride's metadata and playlist (song order, artists, in-class liked-flag, start-time offsets). The workout's ride_id from `workouts list` is the input here. Some on-demand rides ship with empty playlists (instructor talk-only) — that's a normal `playlist.songs: []`, not an error. Required: rideID. Returns the RideDetails.

tools.name: workouts_get
tools.description: Get a single workout by id, with the same ride/instructor join surface as `list`. Required: workoutID. Optional: joins (default: ride,ride.instructor). Returns the Workout.

tools.name: workouts_list
tools.description: List the authenticated user's workouts, newest-first. Uses joins=ride,ride.instructor to pull the ride title, instructor name, and ride id alongside each workout. Required: userID. Optional: page (default: 0), limit (default: 20), joins (default: ride,ride.instructor). Returns array of Workout.

params.name: userID
params.description: Peloton user id (32-char hex from `me`). The auth0|<id> prefix on the Auth0 sub claim is stripped — pass the bare id only.

params.name: joins
params.description: Comma-separated entity joins. The default pulls ride metadata + instructor name with the same shape the SPA uses.
